## EXCERIA PLUS G3 NVMe™ SSD

Upgrade Your PC's Potential

Welcome to the world of PCIe ® 4.0

The KIOXIA EXCERIA PLUS G3 SSD series features a powerful PCIe ® 4.0 interface and delivers improved performance for gamers and video editors. With up to 2TB of capacity, this M.2 2280 single-sided series is excellent for mainstream desktops and notebooks that support the latest PCIe ® 4.0

 

Capacity

1 TB, 2 TB

5000/3900 MB/s

770 000/950 000 IOPS (1 TB) 680 000/950 000 IOPS (2 TB)

BiCS FLASH™, NVMe™ 1.4 Technology, M.2 2280 Form Factor, PCIe ® Gen4 x4, SSD Utility Management Software

 

## EXCERIA G3 NVMe™ SSD

Next-Gen Speed

First Step into PCIe ® 5.0 Performance

Take your first step into PCIe ® 5.0 Performance. The KIOXIA EXCERIA G3 SSD Series, an entry-level model supporting PCIe ® 5.0, takes performance to the next level with up to 10 000 MB/s of sequential read speed *1, not only accelerating everyday PC tasks, but also supporting AI applications and helping build a comfortable gaming environment. Leveraging BiCS FLASH™ 3D flash memory, this updated SSD series now offers up to 4TB of capacity in a M.2 2280 form factor suitable for both desktops and notebooks.

This Warranty Statement applies to SSDs listed under Clause 1. and purchased from 20 February 2023 by Consumers in the geographical area of Europe, in a member state of the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS), the Middle East (including Turkey and Israel) and all countries on the African continent, including the islands (such as Madagascar) (altogether “Territory”). However, it does not apply to so called ‘parallel imports’, i.e., to SSDs where the first import into the Territory was done by another party than KIOXIA. KIOXIA reserves the right to determine whether or not an SSD is a parallel import. Please contact the dealer or retailer from which you have purchased such parallel imports for available warranty, if any.

Your original purchase invoice (sales receipt), showing the date of purchase, model number and serial number of the SSD, is your proof of the date of purchase.

3.3 The warranty period of a replacement product is thirty (30) days from the date of replacement or the remainder of the original warranty period of the replaced SSD, whichever is longer.

3.4 Claims based on this warranty outside the warranty period will not be accepted.
